title: Sharp Studio
oneLiner: Hackable image processing tool for conversion, resizing, and compression

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: Image processing tools are often rigid, making it hard to customize workflows for different optimization needs.

myRole.heading: Role
myRole.description: Designed and built the tool end-to-end, focusing on flexibility, performance, and ease of use.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Built a web-based tool for converting, resizing, and compressing images with configurable processing pipelines.

impact.heading: Impact
impact.description: Provided a fast and flexible way to process images, enabling more control over optimization workflows.
